newsitem.title: USA: Washington Post forms photo venture.
newsitem.headline: Washington Post forms photo venture.

text.p: Washington Post Co and District Photo Inc, a photo-finishing company, have formed Photo Store LLC, a venture that will sell photographs from the Washington Post, Newsweek and other collections, the companies said Monday.

Images include popular, archival and historic photographs of notable people, places and events. Photos in the PhotoStore collection can be viewed and ordered by mail, telephone or via the PhotoStore World Wide Web site on the Internet.
